meaning:
Kartah = "city"
a town in Zebulun allotted to the Merarite Levites
Another name of qit.ron (קִטְרוֹן "Kitron" H7003)

elsewhere.note: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,
